title: Support access
description: You decide when platform support staff may enter your company's panel, for how long and with which rights. Every access is recorded.
forbidden: You are not allowed to manage support access.
load_failed: Support access grants could not be loaded.
empty_description: When the support team needs to look at your panel, open a time-boxed access here.
empty_filtered_description: Change the filters and try again.
banner.none_title: Support staff cannot enter your panel right now
banner.none_body: Unless you open access, platform support staff cannot sign in to your company.
banner.active_body: Access closes by itself on {{date}}. You can revoke it at any time.
scopes.read_only_hint: Support staff can see records but cannot change anything.
scopes.full_hint: Support staff can act with the rights of the user they enter as. Every action is recorded.
fields.note_hint: What the support team should look at (optional).
open.title: Open support access
open.description: Platform support staff can enter your panel for the period you choose.
open.description_replace: An access is already open; the new one replaces it.
revoke.title: Revoke support access?
revoke.description: Support staff lose access at once; their open sessions are refused on the next request.
validation.duration: Choose a duration between 1 hour and 7 days.
validation.note: The note can be at most 500 characters.
